$doNotEditByHand: Re-run the generator and review the diff. scripts/validate-midground.mjs re-runs it and fails if this file is not what the seed produces.
rules: Every instance clears the authored run-off lip (halfWidth + apronWidth) by at least 1.5 m plus its own footprint radius, measured against every station within 120 m and not only its own.
No instance comes within 6 m of a P12 signage board footprint.
No instance taller than 2.5 m stands in a board's 80 m approach within 13 m of its lateral.
No instance comes within 3 m of an authored massing footprint.

lateral is signed in the RUNTIME convention (course.sample's `right` = cross(tangent, worldUp)), which is the opposite sign to the station table's `normal` and to MASSING_PLACEMENTS' lateral_offset_m.
yawDeg is measured from the course tangent at the instance's own distance. WINDROW_RIDGE yaws are pre-resolved so the ridge lies across the 292 deg wind in WORLD space.

lift is metres of the instance origin above the pan floor; 0 for anything standing on the ground, the screen top-edge height for SCREEN_BAY, and negative for CRUST_PLATE so its low corner sinks instead of the slab balancing on its centre.
